objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object such as a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision cycle.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period for extended validity check cycle (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment, follows the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document linked to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status controlled via switches in properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, created and managed independently without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering the out-of-force process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person in the system who can hold roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License role assigned to the user (e.g. Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for authorization assignment such as reader groups, author groups, reviewer groups, releaser groups, and archive groups.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for distribution by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance supporting approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement processes.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Role of the signer in the workflow step (e.g. Author, Reviewer, Releaser).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving and displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects during the review step.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of review performed (technical or formal).

evts.name: reject_during_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejecting the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_during_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejecting the document.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions are made to content, attachments are changed, or change proposals are implemented.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly due to lack of criticality.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, and the creator receives notification.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date by the default period.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override process is completed, the document receives Out of Force status, and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with retained metadata and restored authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users of workflow task status or existence via email notification.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g. workflow task, validity extension, override, acknowledgement).

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write permissions are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or write).

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is linked to a main document.

A user is assigned to one or more user groups that determine authorization and role.
A distribution list is maintained per document for email and acknowledgement distribution.
A distribution list contains user groups assigned for distribution.
A distribution list contains individual persons assigned for distribution.
An electronic signature is documented for each workflow step completed by a participant.
